title: March of the Machine | Episode 1: Triumph of the Fleshless

entities.name: Elesh Norn
entities.description: The Phyrexian Grand Praetor who dispatches her evangels to every corner of the Multiverse and executes Sheoldred.

entities.name: Kaya
entities.description: A planeswalker held captive in the sanctum, who phases through matter and is encased in stone before being released.

entities.name: Kaito Shizuki
entities.description: A planeswalker held captive in the sanctum and released as a messenger.

entities.name: Tyvar Kell
entities.description: A planeswalker held captive in the sanctum who struggles against his stone bonds.

entities.name: Sheoldred
entities.description: A Phyrexian thane stripped of her armor who is brought before Norn bound and executed by Ajani.

entities.name: Lukka
entities.description: A compleated Phyrexian evangel sent to Ikoria to bring the monsters into the fold.

entities.name: Ajani
entities.description: A compleated Phyrexian evangel who executes Sheoldred and is sent to Theros to bring its gods to Phyrexia.

entities.name: Atraxa
entities.description: A winged Phyrexian angel loyal to Norn, given the task of harvesting New Capenna and destroying Halo's wellspring.

entities.name: Nahiri
entities.description: A compleated kor lithomancer evangel who is sent to Zendikar to wake a Skyclave.

entities.name: Nissa Revane
entities.description: A compleated elf who steers Realmbreaker's portals and attention at Norn's side.

entities.name: Tamiyo
entities.description: A compleated evangel who hesitates when Norn tests her loyalty over Kamigawa.

entities.name: Jace Beleren
entities.description: A compleated evangel who departs ahead of Norn's commands.

entities.name: Realmbreaker
entities.description: The corrupted World Tree whose barbed limbs anchor on other planes, releasing pods of Phyrexian forces.

entities.name: The Argent Etchings
entities.description: Norn's holy teachings, rendered in metal.

entities.name: Halo
entities.description: The golden haze over New Capenna, which Norn says is the remains of the angels' ethereal forms.

entities.name: New Phyrexia
entities.description: The compleated plane from which Norn directs the invasion of the Multiverse.

entities.name: Zendikar
entities.description: Nahiri's birth plane, with ancient forests and a floating Skyclave city.

entities.name: Ikoria
entities.description: Lukka's home plane, with monsters that Phyrexia wants.

entities.name: Kamigawa
entities.description: Tamiyo's former home, a neon-lit night city targeted for invasion.

entities.name: Theros
entities.description: Ajani's target plane, a sunlit land of gods guarded by a temple statue.

entities.name: New Capenna
entities.description: A golden plane shrouded in Halo where angels once sealed away a Phyrexian ship.

entities.name: The Skyclave
entities.description: An ancient floating weapon of Nahiri's people, ringed by hedrons.

entities.name: Sanctum
entities.description: Elesh Norn's inner sanctum on New Phyrexia, where portals show invaded planes.

entities.name: The Phyrexian evangels
entities.description: Compleated former planeswalkers sent to spread Phyrexia's gospel.

entities.name: Phyrexians
entities.description: The unified compleated horde.

entities.name: Compleation
entities.description: The Phyrexian process of transformation into a unified being.

events.summary: Norn confronts three captive planeswalkers, Kaya, Kaito and Tyvar, who defy her offer.
events.quote: Behold the glory of New Phyrexia.

events.summary: Norn summons portals to five planes where Realmbreaker's limbs anchor and release pods of Phyrexian forces.
events.quote: Realmbreaker's massive, barb-tipped limbs burst forth, anchoring themselves wherever they please.

events.summary: Lukka, Ajani, Atraxa and Nahiri bring in the bound Sheoldred as an offering.
events.quote: Carried like a trussed up offering between them is the once powerful Sheoldred.

events.summary: Norn has Nahiri encase the three planeswalkers in stone and tells them to be her prophets.
events.quote: You shall be the prophets of our coming,

events.summary: Norn orders Ajani to execute Sheoldred for craving power over unity, and he beheads her.
events.quote: Sheoldred's head bounces to a stop at her feet

events.summary: Norn lets the captive planeswalkers escape deliberately so they can spread her gospel.
events.quote: Elesh Norn counts on them escaping.

events.summary: Norn announces the evangels will unite their homelands and asks Nahiri where she was born.
events.quote: we have decided to grant you the honor of uniting your homelands.

events.summary: Norn has Nissa show Zendikar's forests and a Skyclave, and Nahiri vows to wake the weapon.
events.quote: I can wake it once more to enact our will.

events.summary: Nahiri departs for Zendikar.
events.quote: In three steps, she winks out of existence

events.summary: Norn sends Lukka to Ikoria to add its monsters to Phyrexian ranks, warning him of the price of failure.
events.quote: Go to Ikoria. Add these monsters to our ranks.

events.summary: Tamiyo and Atraxa discuss Lukka's likely fate and Norn's strategy.
events.quote: Either way Phyrexia is served.

events.summary: Norn shows Tamiyo the night-lit city of Kamigawa and asks whether she still loves it and her family.
events.quote: Do you still care for your family?

events.summary: Realmbreaker pierces Kamigawa's city as Tamiyo watches a mother save her children, and a man in black deflects falling tiles.
events.quote: Realmbreaker pierces the earth.

events.summary: Tamiyo falters when told to welcome the old into the new, and Atraxa reprimands her.
events.quote: Insolence isn't tolerated here. You were given a command.

events.summary: Norn commands Tamiyo to return with Kamigawa under her control or be recycled.
events.quote: Return with Kamigawa under your control or be recycled into something that serves better.

events.summary: Ajani correctly guesses Theros is his destination, a first-wave target.
events.quote: You want to see Theros.

events.summary: Phyrexian forces rain onto Theros, devouring livestock and humans.
events.quote: It starts the same as it did on Kamigawa

events.summary: Norn orders Ajani to bring a guardian god of Theros within Phyrexia's embrace and to bring priests and the Argent Etchings.
events.quote: Bring priests with you,

events.summary: Ajani departs for Theros while Norn hides her real reason for sending him.
events.quote: he did not discover the real reason she'd sent him to Theros.

events.summary: Norn tells Atraxa about the Phyrexian ship sealed away by angels on New Capenna and shows her the city.
events.quote: Angels. False prophets bound to stone for their insolence,

events.summary: Norn orders Atraxa to harvest New Capenna and destroy the wellspring of Halo.
events.quote: You will harvest them all.

events.summary: Norn reveals a danger to New Phyrexia exists on New Capenna and Theros, which Atraxa and Ajani must seal.
events.quote: In killing New Capenna, we strike at her heart.

events.summary: Left alone, Norn calls attendants to recite her teachings to drive away her nightmares of the woman in white.
events.quote: Elesh Norn forgets her nightmares

relations.quote: Sheoldred's head bounces to a stop at her feet

relations.note: condemns her as a pretender to praeterdom
relations.quote: Phyrexia no longer has a place for those who crave power over unity.
Ajani, ever loyal, does as he is told.

relations.note: she shaped Atraxa's body with her own hands
relations.quote: the woman who shaped Atraxa's body with her own two hands
Norn's lieutenant is too preoccupied with managing the tree's growth to speak with her.
she might overtake Tamiyo as Norn's favorite new servant
You wear your new purpose as well as you wear your raiment.
